topic: Compilation of players versus referees: pushing, confrontations and Pique's '6 refs' rant
hero: Gerard Piqué (Barcelona #3, identified by shirt) and a bald referee
hook: Muddy-pitch clip: red-kit player and sky-blue player with referee in yellow, music intro
subtitle_style: bold white sans-serif, black outline, bottom-centre, bubble boxes for key shouts ('THE REF GETS PUSHED!', 'YOU HAVE 6 REFS', '6 REFS!'); angry-emoji sticker later
reaction_overlays: red circle highlighters, dark spotlight vignette, angry-face emoji sticker with %$@ symbols, TEOCRI watermark
transition_summary: Hard cuts, spotlight dissolves; about 3-5 cuts per 10 s
audio_note: Original match audio and commentary; transcript partly commentary ('Damir won't leave it alone ... Red Card') plus music

reuse_segments.what: Referee confrontation clips from multiple matches and Piqué rant
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: licensed clips only; keep caption/circle style
